18:0 PEG2000 PE (Ammonium Salt)
A80120 (Legacy code 880120)
1,2-distearoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine-N-[methoxy(polyethylene glycol)-2000] (ammonium salt)

18:0 PEG2000 PE, or 1,2-distearoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine-N-[methoxy(polyethylene glycol)-2000] (ammonium salt), is a high-purity, synthetic phospholipid conjugated with polyethylene glycol (PEG). This PEGylated phospholipid consists of distearoylphosphatidylethanolamine (DSPE) and methoxy-terminated PEG with a molecular weight of 2000. The ammonium salt form improves this phospholipid’s aqueous solubility and is ideal for incorporating into liposomal formulations and other drug delivery systems.

The lipid provides steric stabilization of liposomes, enhancing circulation time and reducing recognition by the reticuloendothelial system (RES).

Product details
Product Type
Lipids
Product Category
PEG / Polymer Lipids - PEG Phospholipids
Application
18:0 PEG2000 PE plays a pivotal role in the formulation of long-circulating, stealth liposomes designed to evade rapid immune clearance. It is widely used in drug and gene delivery systems where stability and extended circulation are highly important. By modifying the surface of nanoparticles, this phospholipid minimizes opsonization and improves biodistribution. This makes it an invaluable component for targeted therapies. Researchers rely on 18:0 PEG2000 PE to develop PEGylated liposomes that improve drug efficacy; its integration into lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) supports advancements in mRNA and RNA-based delivery systems.
